- Eng: "Hands-on Benchmark Lab: Measure & Optimize LLM Inference in 15 Minutes"
- PM: "Benchmarking for Decisions: Key Metrics to Move to Production"
- Exec: "Predictable Inference Spend: A Quick Playbook"

```
pip install redwood-infer-sdk
python micro_bench.py --model small-quant --prompt prompts.txt
```
